what: Plan initializes phase2_relaunch_count beside fallback_count after the grouped phase-2 fall-through path that will increment it
scenario_or_breakage: A reuse copy failure reaches the planned phase2_relaunch_count=$((phase2_relaunch_count + 1)) before assignment; with set -u, bash exits with an unbound variable instead of relaunching the slot
suggested_fix: Initialize phase2_relaunch_count=0 before the grouped phase-2 loop, for example near phase2_grouped_failed=(), and keep fallback_count=0 at the phase-3 loop
